6 axes compared between the 1751 and 1749 works, including the printed plate size, the scale and the atlas numbering

the 1749 reduction is by the same author and counts as zero additional independent sources

registry, lineage, assessment and two copy rows for the 1751 pair

not one observation rests on a symbol the rule excludes

a stroke enters as one scalar equation at its own pixel; no stroke is crossed with another
42 true two-dimensional observations, against a target of 16 and a preferred 24
true 2D 42, longitude-only 56, latitude-only 48, each counted on its own

sheet N 22, sheet S 20

10 model fits over two sheets, including the graticule-constrained variants
one model selected per sheet, on holdout rms with a 10 per cent tolerance, simplest first

four estimators over two sheets, all from the engraved strokes; the transform maps pixels straight to Greenwich and the meridian is diagnostic
